items.label: Basalt
items.fact: Basalt is cooled lava — most of the ocean floor is made of it!

items.label: Granite
items.fact: Granite cooled slowly underground, growing big sparkly crystals.

items.label: Obsidian
items.fact: Obsidian is volcano glass — lava that cooled super fast!

items.label: Sandstone
items.fact: Sandstone is squashed sand — you can sometimes see the layers!

items.label: Chalk
items.fact: Chalk is made of squillions of tiny sea-creature shells.

items.label: Limestone
items.fact: Limestone often hides fossils — it formed on ancient sea beds.

items.label: Marble
items.fact: Marble is limestone that got squeezed and heated — a rock makeover!

items.label: Slate
items.fact: Slate splits into flat sheets — perfect for roofs. It used to be mudstone!

items.label: Quartzite
items.fact: Quartzite is sandstone toughened by heat and pressure — super hard!
